svg.data-weight-note: 30 kg (datasheet and guide spec table; configuration not stated)
svg.data-power-input: 100-240 VAC auto-ranging 47-63 Hz, or 180-300 VDC auto input
svg.data-cpu: Intel Xeon D x86, 4-core (up to 8-core), 2.9 GHz, COM Express
svg.data-bmc: optional BMC system management - RunBMC, OpenBMC
svg.data-breakout: guide, System Breakout Capabilities: 1 x 800G, 2 x 400G, 4 x 200G, 2 x 200G, 8 x 100G, 1 x 400G and 4 x 100G modes; odd-numbered front ports support up to 8x breakout and even-numbered up to 2x ("due to ASIC limitation").
svg.data-timing: IEEE 1588 1-step and 2-step time stamping; transparent and boundary clock; SyncE clock recovery (timing option)
svg.data-optics-osfp: OSFP 800G optics and DAC: up to 20 W / 30 W transceivers, up to 4 m DAC, ZR/ZR+ coherent modules supported; up to 16 ports of 30 W optics on ports 1, 5, 9, 13, 49, 53, 57, 61 (upper row) and 4, 8, 12, 16, 52, 56, 60, 64 (bottom row). Tested in the guide's breakout table: OSFP 2x FR4 (dual duplex LC), OSFP 2x VR4 and 2x DR4 (dual MPO-8), OSFP DR8 (MPO-16) and a 400G OSFP AOC.
svg.data-optics-sfp28: SFP28 25G optics; the guide notes 1G transceivers are supported once speed and FEC are configured. No SFP28 module is listed in the tested table.

The datasheet lists them among the interfaces with no role.
